verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM documents single-agent features: AI agents, custom agent skills, 'Agent Flows' (title only), 'custom agent workflows', and MCP compatibility. None of the evidence describes subagents, swarms, an agent-to-agent protocol, or splitting and parallelizing work across cooperating agents. Agent Flows, custom skills and MCP tool connectivity are adjacent features, not multi-agent orchestration, so they earn no credit.
